remainingRisks: No paid Jev or native provider inference was run in this repair; entitlement, actual served model/effort, answer quality and real billing remain unverified. Official Mythos documentation supports all five API effort levels, but native Claude Code upstream acceptance/enforcement across all five was not established by controlled dispatcher tests.
Claude remains best-effort if its native extension dispatcher itself is absent, fails or times out.
API reference rates do not establish subscription quota savings or a measured cost optimum; token amounts/cache/billing regime are unknown.
Reviewed registries and price references need manual review by 2026-11-18; unknown IDs remain fail-closed.
